{{Top|leg}}
'''Fostering''' was a practice in which two individuals from two different families became a foster child of the other's family for six [[Standard month/Legends|months]]. Each child would be treated as a full member of the family they were with. Around [[25,793 BBY]] [[Oma Dessain]] and [[Brom Santis]] would participate in this practice in order to form a treaty between the management and [[Miner/Legends|employees]] of [[Dessain Mining]].<ref name="Eruption">{{InsiderCite|141|Eruption}}</ref>
